consequence.statement: Bucket objects written through the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 schema whose status.artifact has no digest are rejected by schema validation.
consequence.remediation: Make sure any client that writes Bucket v1beta2 status (normally source-controller) sets status.artifact.digest, or move to source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1.

assertion.statement: Between the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles, the Bucket source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 CRD schema makes status.artifact.digest required, so objects whose artifact has no digest are rejected.

checks.detail: crd-field now-required is not render-verifiable (runtime-only or no rendered shape)
